preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(line.strip()) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string has length between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().isalpha() and line.strip().islower() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
The first line is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) matching the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] in ['YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no', 'Yes', 'No', 'yEs', 'nO'] and (stdout.splitlines()[i].lower() == 'yes' if (len(s := stdin.splitlines()[i+1].strip()) % 2 == 0 and s == s[:len(s)//2] * 2) else stdout.splitlines()[i].lower() == 'no')) for i in range(len(stdin.splitlines()) - 1))
postconditions.description: For each test case string s, output 'YES' if s is square (i.e., s is formed by concatenating a string of length len(s)/2 with itself), otherwise output 'NO'. Case insensitivity is allowed for the output.
